label: swap the two echo pre-filter halves
round an echo pre-filter tap to three decimals
why: 0.467999995f and 0.468f are the SAME float, 0x3eef9db2 both.  Nine significant digits is float's round-trip width, so 0.467999995 IS how 0.468f prints and not a finer value that rounding would lose.

label: flatten the echo pre-filter's smallest tap to zero
round an echo pre-filter tap to four decimals, which does move it
